# Recompiled TTT2 game code (re/ppc, generated by XenonRecomp - never committed)
# built as an ARM64 static library with the Android NDK.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(ttt2_ppc_android CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
get_filename_component(ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(TTT2_PPC_OPT_LEVEL "2" CACHE STRING "Optimization level for recompiled PPC code")
file(GLOB PPC_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${ROOT}/re/ppc/ppc_recomp.*.cpp"
    "${ROOT}/re/ppc/ppc_func_mapping.cpp")
list(LENGTH PPC_SOURCES N)
if(N EQUAL 0)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "re/ppc is empty - run stage 1 (XenonRecomp) first")
endif()
add_library(tekken_ppc STATIC ${PPC_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(tekken_ppc PRIVATE
    "${ROOT}/re/ppc"
    "${ROOT}/tools/XenonRecomp/XenonUtils"
    "${ROOT}/tools/XenonRecomp/thirdparty/simde")
# -ffp-contract=off: keep PPC multiply and add separate (no fused FMA), as on PC.
# simde maps the VMX128 (SSE-style) code to NEON on ARM64.
target_compile_options(tekken_ppc PRIVATE
    "-O${TTT2_PPC_OPT_LEVEL}" -ffp-contract=off -fno-strict-aliasing -g0
    -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -Wno-everything
    -include "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ppc_arm64_shim.h")
